periods.time: vol-10 ch-004, shortly before the semifinal second match

name.en: Ikki thanks Shizuku before facing Amane

periods.summary: On his way to the preparation room, Ikki meets Shizuku and Alice just after they wake from Amane's attack. Shizuku hides in shame and apologizes for failing to stop Amane, but Ikki embraces her and tells her that she fought not only for him but also for the dignity of every knight in the festival. Alice asks whether Ikki has a plan against Amane's causality; Ikki says he has no countermeasure, but after learning Amane's true identity he is certain that only Amane cannot defeat him.
periods.cause: Shizuku's failed illegal ambush left her ashamed and Ikki wants to see her before his semifinal.
periods.outcome: Shizuku regains emotional footing, and Ikki enters the semifinal carrying her will rather than condemning her.
periods.significance: Clarifies Ikki's compassion toward Shizuku and his psychological readiness to confront Amane as a mirror of his own past despair.
